settings.heading: A threshold between the known and the unknown.
settings.body:
Sleep is part of every life, yet the experience of dreaming remains a source of curiosity. MƎR LIMEN begins with that sense of wonder—not with claims of certainty.

We curate considered essentials for the rituals around rest, and make space for the questions that arrive when the world grows quiet.

settings.heading: Looking closer at sleep.
settings.body: The REM cycle is one useful window into the changing patterns of a night. Our diagram is here as a point of reference and curiosity, not as a diagnostic tool.

settings.heading: Curiosity, without easy answers.
settings.body: We believe the hours spent asleep deserve thoughtful attention. Our role is simple: offer useful objects, communicate clearly, and stay curious about the extraordinary experience of being conscious—and of dreaming.

settings.heading: Find your own way into the night.
settings.body: Explore the collection and build a ritual that feels like your own.
